boxery — remote desktop VMs for coding agents

Usage:
  boxery [--host NAME] COMMAND [ARGS...]

Getting started:
  setup user@host|local                 Configure a VM host (local = this machine), register your ssh key
  help [--all | COMMAND]                Show help for boxery, a command or a family action

VMs:
  ls                                    List VMs: every host's, a section each (--host NAME: one)
  new NAME                              Create a VM
  start NAME                            Start a stopped VM (pins its ssh host key where it can)
  stop NAME                             Stop a VM
  rm NAME                               Destroy a VM and its snapshots (revokes its LLM token)
  resize NAME                           Change a VM's size (restarts it if running; disk only grows)
  fork SRC DST...                       Copy a VM (running or not) into new VMs, ~10 s
  patch NAME|--all                      Update a VM's guest software to the host's image layers

Work in a VM:
  ssh NAME[@HOST] [CMD...]              Shell into a VM (also: ssh NAME.boxery)
  run NAME CMD [ARG...]                 Run a command in ~/project, args as given (like docker exec)
  cp FROM TO                            Copy files and directories to, from and between VMs
  sync NAME                             Push a local git checkout into a VM, so its tree matches exactly
  desktop NAME                          Open a VM's desktop in your browser (noVNC over ssh)
  forward NAME PORT [LOCAL]             Forward a VM port to localhost
  attach NAME [AGENT]                   Attach to an agent in a persistent tmux session (= agent attach)
  prompt NAME "TASK"                    Start a headless pi task as a background job (= agent prompt)

Command families (boxery FAMILY --help):
  host add|ls|show|use|rm|…             Named hosts, and maintenance of the selected host
  snapshot create|ls|restore|rm|images  Saved VM disk states: create, restore, list, delete
  agent attach|prompt|ls                Persistent coding-agent sessions in a VM
  job ls|logs|wait|kill                 Background jobs in a VM (run --bg starts one)
  access grant|revoke|ls|apply          What a VM may use from this machine (grants)
  lease acquire|renew|release|ls        Borrow a VM from the shared pool
  pool add|rm|ls                        Manage the shared pool of leasable VMs (admin)
  runners once|status|...               GitHub Actions runners on pool VMs

More:
  pin NAME                              Re-pin a VM's ssh host key (VMs made before keys were pinned)
  shapes                                VM sizes on every host (* = default; --host NAME: one)
  version                               Controller and every host's version; warns per host

Options:
  --host NAME                           Run COMMAND on a host other than the default (boxery host use)
  --json                                JSON output on listings (fields: docs/cli.md#json-output)
  -h, --help                            Show help; boxery COMMAND --help shows a command's
  help --all                            Every command, every family action and every older spelling

Docs: https://github.com/modem-dev/boxery/blob/master/docs/cli.md
Agents: prefer the vm_* tools (boxery-mcp or the pi extension): https://github.com/modem-dev/boxery/blob/master/docs/mcp.md
